question: why 2 tests skipped in the full run when Mission 5.7 reported 0
method: the only conditional skips in the suite are t.skip calls in tests/security-integrations.test.ts (opa x2, gitleaks x2) and tests/self-view.test.ts (no headless browser / browser could not start x2); those two files were re-run alone to see which fire
note: a t.skip is reported as skipped, while the '[skipped] no IndexedDB in this runtime' line in the suite log is a console message from the conversation-memory test, not one of the two counted skips
